Author: R.K. Pattanaik

 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crlrev No.336 of 2025
 Sibasish @ Subasish Das @ Tikina ....

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Ms. A. Mehta, Advocate
 -Versus-
 State of Odisha and another ....

Opposite Parties
 Ms. B. Dash, Asc
 Coram:
 Mr. Justice R.K. Pattanaik
 Order
04.09.2025 Order No.
03. 1.
As per the office note, neither AD nor undelivered notice is received back from opposite party No.2.
The postal tracking report is at Flag-T and it is revealed that notice has been dispatched and still to be served on opposite party No.2.
But, Ms. Dash, learned ASC for the State submits to the Court that the informant, namely, opposite party No.2 has engaged a counsel in the meantime.

However, no one appears for and on behalf of opposite party No.2 at the time of call.
2.

Recorded the submission of Ms. Mehta, learned counsel for the petitioner, according to whom, a charge under Section 376 (2)(n) IPC is not made out as the relationship between the parties to be a consensual one.
3. As a last chance, awaiting appearance of opposite party No.2, further hearing of the matter is adjourned to be listed on 22nd September, 2025.
4. Interim order passed by this Court shall remain in force till the next date of listing.

(R.K. Pattanaik) Judge Rojina Designation: Junior Stenographer Sibasish @ Subasish Das @ Tikina vs State Of Odisha And Another .... ... on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29078141/
